accessibility_note: accessibility_penalty is dna_design_suite.codon.orchestrator.structure_diag.evaluate after the design: mean -log unpaired probability, window 6 nt, span 40 nt, 37 C. It was not an objective of either optimiser in this run.
corpus_rule: First gene in each of ['short', 'medium', 'long', 'very_long'] from generality_sample.json with nt >= 150, gene not in ['rpsL', 'waaS', 'lacZ', 'yeeJ'], sorted by (nt, gene).
optimizer_commit_note: main at the time of the run. No file under crates/ or python/ was edited for this measurement.

rows.objective_note: DNA Design Suite usage.cai, budget standard, generations 4, stagnation window 21, seed 7, host escherichia_coli:511145/MG1655, translation table 11. Same job shape as docs/benchmarks/v2.9.3-external-comparison.md.

DNA Chisel MaximizeCAI via CodonOptimize(method='use_best_codon') on the ribosomal relative-adaptiveness table. Reported CAI is the independent Sharp and Li mean, which excludes Met, Trp and stops. Zero floor inside DNA Chisel is 0.001; minimum positive ribosomal weight is 0.002392; floor does not reorder positive codons: True.
cai_greedy picks the highest relative adaptiveness at each codon and breaks ties toward the lexicographically smaller codon. It does not see constraints.
The input CDS. Not an optimiser.
